summary: Acer Aspire 5 15 (A515-57R9, A515-58R7) with AMD Ryzen 5 7520U Quad-Core Processor, 8GB LPDDR5 RAM, 256GB NVMe SSD, and Full HD IPS Display (1920x1080, 60Hz), experiencing thermal throttling issues.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to inadequate cooling system maintenance and outdated BIOS/Driver versions.
suggested_solution: Update BIOS to latest version (F.20h) and Driver Updates for AMD Radeon Graphics Driver to 22.10.1, perform regular cleaning of dust from vents and fans, and use thermal monitoring software.
